title: GeoBoundary
description: A program's canonical geographic boundary plus its registered reference points (withinRadius centers). The `boundary` member is the content-addressed payload: boundary_id = urn:ixo:geo-boundary:<CIDv1(raw, sha256)> of its canonical-JSON bytes (sorted keys, no whitespace), verified by the graph oracle before every geo answer and anchorable verbatim as a collection LinkedResource when the engine's geo v2 surface activates (rfc-005 §3.2). Geometry is always a MultiPolygon of closed integer micro-degree rings — exterior counterclockwise, holes clockwise, no edge spanning the antimeridian (RFC 7946 §3.1.9 pre-split). Ring closure, winding, and edge-span rules exceed JSON Schema and are enforced by scripts/lib/geo.mjs validateBoundary(). Re-drawing a boundary is a new artifact with a new address, never an edit.
